title: Choose the visual world
question: Re-roll steered toward Akari: paper that holds light. Lock one, steer, or roll again. Gravity-rain garden and the single-hue toy program left this hand: they fail the stakeholder-trust test.

options.label: Diazo Hang
options.lineage: Translucent diazo prints clipped to a wire in a print room
options.thesis: The landing is a hang of Clearwater sheets backlit by the window: paper holds the light, Longest Path is the print that goes fully translucent, Request Access means you may unclip a copy.
options.viewport: A dim print room, a wire of hanging translucent programmes across the viewport, the Clearwater sheet glowing, SADICONSTRUCTION on a level title rail, Request Access as a vermilion unclip-stamp.
options.risk: Sepia drawing-hang is a construction-website cliché if the sheets read as decoration instead of issued prints.

raised.raise: Each hanging sheet wears a kraft band: BOQ phase, working days, float remaining.
Print-room amber floods every surface; the only white is light through the film.
The glowing sheet is dense with linework; Longest Path is a one-frame inversion of that field.
Time is an etched graticule behind the hang; bars are measured against it, not placed by eye.

options.label: Planning Lightbox
options.lineage: A planner’s light table stacked with tracing overlays
options.thesis: Access is being invited to the light table: BOQ on the bottom sheet, the network traced over it, Longest Path the overlay that actually catches the bulb.
options.viewport: Top-down light table filling the screen, stacked overlays slightly offset, vermilion Request Access stamp on the table edge, Clearwater phase names readable through the paper.
options.risk: The architect-website default: a glowing drawing table as hero.

options.label: Folded J-Card
options.lineage: photocopied cassette j-cards that unfold panel by panel
options.thesis: The landing is a folded issued sheet: the cover is the project, unfolding reveals the programme, the spine is the activity list.
options.viewport: A gray photocopy cover filling the first viewport, Sadiconstruction in cramped ink, a small crosshatched key plan, numbered spine of leaf activities; the fold peek shows the Longest Path inside.
options.case: Holds product clarity: unfolding is how drawings are actually read, and the inside can be the path. Loses audience identification: bedroom-tape photocopy is not a planning office until the fold is trusted.
options.risk: Reads as a zine, not an internal construction platform, if the photocopy grit outranks the issued sheet.

options.label: Pickling Brine Calendar
options.lineage: seasonal jars maturing on a shelf
options.thesis: Projects as jars; working days as brine time; float as cloudiness.
options.viewport: A shelf of labeled jars; Clearwater is the batch in front.
options.case: A kitchen calendar does not identify this planning office, and jars hide BOQ as WBS.
options.risk: Culinary theater a PM would not put in front of stakeholders.
options.kept: Each sheet banded with phase, working days, and float.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: The network as a barcode wall; Longest Path as a full-frame inversion.
options.viewport: A wall of vertical bars with Clearwater metrics in the margin.
options.case: Media-art density does not identify a construction PM, and a barcode hides the BOQ phases.
options.risk: Cold strobe is the opposite of the paper-and-light steer.
options.kept: The glowing sheet is dense with linework; Longest Path inverts that field once.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on a lab bench
options.thesis: Calendar as timebase; the programme as a triggered phosphor trace.
options.viewport: One graticule, Clearwater’s path locked still by the trigger.
options.case: A lab instrument does not identify this office, and a trace-Gantt hides that cost phases own the rows.
options.risk: Dark phosphor reads as the neon-instrument anti-goal.
options.kept: Time as an etched graticule everything is measured against.

canonCard.label: Construction marketing landing
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships: site hero, orange banner, serif tagline, fake stats, request access.
canonCard.viewport: Full-bleed site photo, left copy panel, Get Access on charcoal, four KPI tiles along the bottom.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the current landing and every contractor brochure site.
